name: Layout Composer
description: Cartographic print layout designer: map frames with locked scale, custom shapes and per-frame layers, DMS/DD/UTM grids, a Word-style ribbon (Insert / Format / Table / Map Frame / Grid tabs), legends for vector, raster and tile layers, attribute tables, Plotly charts (21 kinds), Mermaid diagrams, HTML blocks, a Symbol dialog, matplotlib-style color bars, LaTeX, Google Fonts and Material Symbols, QGIS .qpt import/export, and PNG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
